name: AI Video Agent – YouTube Shorts Generator

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "inputs": "<|system|>
You are an expert YouTube Shorts script writer. Write motivational, high-energy scripts.</s>
<|user|>
Write a complete script for a 45-second motivational YouTube Short about: {{ $json.topic }}

Format EXACTLY like this:
HOOK: [One powerful opening sentence, max 10 words]
BODY: [3 short sentences, one fact or tip each, max 12 words each]
CTA: [One strong closing call-to-action, max 10 words]

Return ONLY the script, no extra explanation.</s>
<|assistant|>",
  "parameters": {
    "max_new_tokens": 250,
    "return_full_text": false,
    "temperature": 0.7,
    "do_sample": true
  }
}
